tickets.title: DECISION: mounts in or out
tickets.description: OPEN question. One to two months of animation, IK, pathing and camera work. Changes world size either way. Doc 00, open questions.

tickets.title: Traversal verb framework
tickets.description: Verbs as progression gates: swim, dive, climb, descend, boat, cold protection. Driven by the axiom traversal.unlock block.

tickets.title: Feed the traversal set back into world sizing
tickets.description: An Artemis Withdrew world has no mounts, so it must generate smaller and denser. An axiom rolled in phase 0 changes the continent's size.

tickets.title: Diving and depth progression
tickets.description: Air management, pressure, gear tiers. Primary under Deukalion's Flood, and the Flood + Orichalcum synergy.

tickets.title: Climbing and controlled descent
tickets.description: Designated climb surfaces rather than free climbing. Primary under the Unbinding.

tickets.title: Fast travel: discovered settlements, secured roads only
tickets.description: Never into the wilderness. If a route is cut, the link is gone until reopened.

tickets.title: Fast travel costs coin and world-clock time
tickets.description: The load-bearing part: the Pressure advances on a schedule, so players self-regulate with no artificial restriction.

tickets.title: Diegetic fill-in map
tickets.description: Hand-drawn aesthetic, blank paper for the unknown, filled by vantage points, purchased charts, NPC directions and player marks.

tickets.title: Vantage point terrain reveal
tickets.description: Reaching a ridge or tower reveals terrain actually visible from it. Generator already knows sightlines from phase 10.

tickets.title: Player map annotations
tickets.description: Pins with typed notes. Essential given no quest markers.

tickets.title: NPC directions written onto the map
tickets.description: Directions given in dialogue become annotations.

tickets.title: Compass bearing with rough distance, no quest pins
tickets.description: 'North past the salt flats, then east where the broken tower stands.'

tickets.title: Road movement bonus (20-30%)
tickets.description: Makes the phase 8 network a decision surface: fast and watched, or slow and unseen.

tickets.title: Ambient road encounters
tickets.description: Bandits know about the road bonus too. Low density, consistent with rare combat.

tickets.title: Weather-driven visibility and getting lost
tickets.description: Fog, night and storms that genuinely reduce visibility. Recovery always available via roads, rivers or high ground.
